lines.1: 「Then all we need to do is enter the wilds of his memory and bring Mr. Tsushima back.」
lines.3: 「I did not earn a teaching license for nothing.」
lines.5: 「I think Inori is the amazing one.」
lines.6: 「Ordinarily, it would be impossible. But with his mind left defenseless by amnesia, it should work.」
lines.7: 「Then let's have the Tsushima family, who've known him for years, come along too.」
lines.9: 「Touch Mr. Tsushima's body, then recite the incantation exactly as I instruct.」
lines.11: 「Oh, amazing. All five look like they sleeping.」
lines.13: 「F-For now, everyone study on your own!」
lines.15: 「Whoa, amazing! Is this Leo's subconscious world?」
lines.16: 「We cannot dive very deeply, so this is only the first layer.」
lines.18: 「For some reason, Crab is running wild all over the place.」
lines.19: 「That's me inside his mind, right? What the heck am I doing?」
lines.20: 「That is Mr. Tsushima's mental image of you, Crab.」
lines.22: 「She just looks like a poor unfortunate soul.」
